note: Aitkin County Land Department rustic campground on the west bank of the Mississippi River, about 1 mile northwest of Jacobson on the Great River Road, in a large block of public land. Wooded sites, two camper cabins and a boat ramp to the river; the Rabey Line ATV trail and a snowmobile trail reach the campground. --Claude
summary: County page, campground map and OneGov read: 12 sites (stored 13; 3 pull-through), primitive, pit toilets, artesian well, $20 a night 2026; online booking closes 7 days out, then first come at a self-pay kiosk. Pin ~2.1 km off (in a field at Jacobson) -> campground. Phone 218-927-7364 added. Website domain moved. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PIN ~2.1 km off: stored 47.0052,-93.2645 sits in an open field beside the Jacobson ballfield, on the far side of town. The county gives 'GPS: 47°01'23"N 93°16'32"W' (47.02306,-93.27556), which on Esri imagery is the boat-ramp clearing on the river; the campground loop road runs through the woods just south of it. Proposed pin 47.0228,-93.2758 (loop centre; pads not visible under canopy).

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the map puts sites 4J-8J along the river side of the loop, but on Esri imagery (47.0225,-93.2760, 130 m) the whole loop is under continuous mixed canopy and only the boat-ramp clearing opens onto the Mississippi (about 45 m wide here). No county site photos are posted (the 'Campground Site Photos' item has no link). Nothing earns a riverview.
OHV side (flag only, no drop): the county lists 'ATV access to the Rabey Line trail' among the amenities. It is a general county campground with a boat ramp and cabins, not a trail staging area.

WEBSITE: https://www.co.aitkin.mn.us/departments/land/land-campground-jacobson.php -> https://www.aitkincountymn.gov/departments/land/land-campground-jacobson.php (old domain redirects). Keep the OneGov line https://mn-co-aitkin-parks.onegov.rtvision.com/dashboard.php?permit=3.
PHONE missing: Aitkin County Land Department 218-927-7364 (on the department page header; OneGov: 'To rent a cabin within the 7-day window please call the office M-F 8am-4:30pm at 218-927-7364').
SITES count 13 -> 12: the county overview line says '13 sites + 2 cabins' but the Jacobson page, OneGov and the map all show 12 sites (1J-12J).
LEAD (already known): Aitkin County's Snake River Campground south of McGrath ('$20/night · Primitive · 12 sites', On the Snake River) is on the county list and is already in RESUME_MN.md's leads.
Season: no dates for Jacobson ('Open for 2026 season'); the water dates given are for Aitkin and Berglund parks only. Left unset.
